# inline

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/inline"
```

Package inline is for CLIs that print logs and now and then ask one question, yes/no or any form field, beside progress.Bar: nothing takes the screen. Theme only: the functions take a theme but keep no Styles to edit.

## Variables

<a name="ErrAborted"></a>ErrAborted is what Confirm returns when the user pressed esc or ctrl\+c.

```go
var ErrAborted = errors.New("inline: aborted")
```

<a name="ErrNoTerminal"></a>ErrNoTerminal is what Confirm and Ask return when no terminal can answer them, as in CI or a cron job: the app falls back to a flag or a default.

```go
var ErrNoTerminal = errors.New("inline: no terminal to ask on")
```

<a name="Ask"></a>
## func [Ask](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/inline/ask.go#L22>)

```go
func Ask[F form.Field](f F, th theme.Resolved, opts ...tea.ProgramOption) (F, error)
```

Ask asks for one form field below the current line and returns it as the user left it: a select or multiselect opens at once, enter answers, esc or ctrl\+c return ErrAborted, no terminal ErrNoTerminal. opts work as in Confirm.

<a name="Confirm"></a>
## func [Confirm](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/inline/inline.go#L24>)

```go
func Confirm(title string, th theme.Resolved, opts ...tea.ProgramOption) (bool, error)
```

Confirm asks a yes/no question below the current line. The default is No; with no terminal to ask on, it returns ErrNoTerminal. opts reach the program: tea.WithContext cancels it, tea.WithInput and tea.WithOutput answer it in a test.
